blocksHtml:

The Wi-Tek WI-CPE511H-KIT V2 is a high-performance 5GHz outdoor wireless transmitter engineered for robust long-range connectivity up to 3KM. Delivering up to 867Mbps wireless throughput and equipped with 100Mbps PoE support, this solution is ideal for point-to-point links, CCTV backhaul, remote area networking, and ISP deployments. Its rugged outdoor design and high-gain antennas ensure stable, reliable performance in challenging environmental conditions.


Features: 


  • Wireless Frequency: 5GHz band for interference-resistant connections
  • Speed: Up to 867Mbps wireless throughput
  • Range: Long-distance transmission up to 3KM
  • PoE: 100Mbps Ethernet with Power over Ethernet support
  • High-Gain Antennas: Focused signal strength for extended reach
  • Outdoor-Ready: Weatherproof housing for all-weather performance
  • Easy Deployment: Pre-configured kit for simple setup
